body: U+0023# PR 187 (mitosis/switch-over) review fixesU+000AU+000ABrief: /Users/satanshumishra/.mitosis/field-notes/review/fix-187.json. Worktree: /Users/satanshumishra/.mitosis/runs/fireplace/items-2e991876d93a/trees/switch-over. Four commits, not pushed.U+000AU+000AU+002D **a9d075f** fix(composer): photo toolbar keeps out of the bottom inset band. photoToolbarOffset only takes the above slot when the bar ends at or above surface.bottom; PhotoToolbarLayer hides the bar when the figure misses the surface above the inset. Tests in photo_toolbar_test.dart: "the bar never takes the slot above a photo that starts in the band under the surface", "it hides while the photo starts inside the bottom inset band". Red without the fix, green with it.U+000AU+002D **40bf968** fix(composer): the overflow "..." control gets firstControlFocusNode when it leads the bar (narrow phone column), via a _PhotoToolbarFocusable interface on the control and a new _PhotoToolbarMenuAnchor wrapper. Test: "Tab lands on the overflow control when it leads a narrow bar". Red, then green.U+000AU+002D **fcf5d97** test: NoteEditorDriver.style (constant) removed. Added firstLineSize, paintedHint and a top-level firstNoteLineSize(RenderNoteView). visibleHintStyle now reads the render object's painted hint (recorded paint, children skipped). The style tests in note_editor_driver_test, text_composer_geometry_test, old_editor_parity_test and note_body_test now compare a laid-out line's width with a TextPainter(TypographyTokens.noteBody) and its height with 16 x 1.6. A bare TextPainter reports 26.0 there; the engine's line box is 25.6. Temporary engine mutations (sans family, w500 weight, hint not painted; all reverted) failed the new tests and passed the old ones. With the loaded fonts, width does separate family (115.57 vs 117.77) and weight (w500 120.82, w700 127.66).U+000AU+002D **ed12a44** test(readers): width tests measure find.descendant(NoteReaderView -> NoteViewBody) instead of the NoteReaderView box: today feed 970, viewer 688 and 720, note_body clamps 720 and narrow 360. With a 35 em cap mutation and a fillsWidth-ignored mutation, the new assertions fail; the old ones missed fillsWidth entirely.U+000AU+000AGates: flutter analyze printed No issues found!; the PR's 37 existing test files passed (443 tests); full flutter test passed (3121). Integration tests were not run (no device).U+000AU+000AOpen: the engine's toolbar-shown flag ignores the band (risk logged); the composer 688-column test measures the editor widget box (risk logged). The commit hook blocked each commit over ship.py, which this run never edited, and does not see `flutter test`, so every commit carried a RECEIPTS_ACK note.
